verdict.rationale: ImageMagick documents a scripting-first CLI for batch jobs and language bindings. These are building blocks a user could wire into external schedulers or scripts, not a product-provided way to set up autonomous, recurring background automations. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in scheduling, watch-folder triggers, or background job management, so the applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
